stations.title: Nadia
stations.say: We charged a choir a penny too much.

captions: At Wrenhaven Scores, Nadia hears that a choir was charged a penny more than its lines.
Its lines add up to one total, and the invoice line shows a penny more.
You catch it in a test, fix the invoice, and test the case next door.
Now every invoice adds up to the penny, whatever the amounts.
Same invoice, same choir. The total is what the lines say.
